'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Sokol LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)|OVS4-11-Local_Uprising-remaster.webp|label=Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Chu's Light
* '''Username:''' mr purple
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
